jobs.title: Life Sciences Data Management, Senior (MDM/DGov)
jobs.description:
Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.  
  
**Position Summary**  
  
Deloitte is seeking a results-oriented professional to join our Life Sciences Commercial Operations practice, building cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions for commercial operations (specializing in CRM (Veeva, Salesforce) data knowledge, Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, specialty pharma data, data governance, Dynamic targeting, Segmentation, Call Planning, Brand planning, Business Intelligence, etc.). This role combines curiosity about the life sciences industry with hands-on skills in analytics, AI/ML, and data to help pharma clients transform their commercial operations. The Senior Consultant will contribute to client engagements, develop AI and analytics solutions, and grow alongside high-performing teams.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Data Management Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:  

* Supporting delivery of AI & Data engagements for Life Sciences / Pharma clients, with emphasis on Commercial AI, analytics, and data transformation
* Building and delivering commercial use cases across account-based selling, HCP/HCO affiliations, dynamic targeting, segmentation, call planning, brand planning, sales and marketing optimization, next best action, and forecasting
* Acquiring, profiling, and analyzing CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), IQVIA (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc), claims, and specialty pharma data, and understanding how Customer MDM structures feed commercial analytics
* Developing, testing, and documenting analytical and AI/ML models that translate commercial business problems into scalable solutions
* Building dashboards and Business Intelligence reporting that turn insights into decisions for field and brand teams
* Applying data governance and data quality practices to the commercial data used in analytics and AI solutions
* Collaborating with strategy, product, data, engineering, and client stakeholder groups to shape solution approach and delivery plans
* Preparing client-ready deliverables, workshop materials, and presentations
* Supporting pursuits and proposal content as needed
* Contributing to practice assets and accelerators, and mentoring junior practitioners

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* 4+ years of professional experience in analytics, AI/ML, or data solutions, including 3+ years in Life Sciences commercial operations (consulting, pharma, or commercial analytics)
* 2+ years hands-on experience with Life Sciences commercial data, such as CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, and specialty pharma data, with working knowledge of Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.)
* 2+ years experience with analytics or AI/ML to commercial use cases such as segmentation, targeting, call planning, next best action, or forecasting
* 2+ years experience with SQL and Python (or R) for data analysis and modeling
* 2+ years experience leading project workstreams and/or project teams, with resources in multiple locations
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

  
**Preferred:**  

* Client-facing consulting experience, including working with teams across multiple locations
* Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Experience with emerging technologies (such as GenAI) and advanced data architectures (i.e., Data Mesh, Data Fabric, Data Products, etc.)
* Experience with Business Intelligence and visualization tools (such as Power BI or Tableau)
* Experience translating business needs into data and analytical requirements and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience with data governance and with regulatory and compliance considerations in life sciences data privacy and security

jobs.title: US Senior Consultant, Customer Success, Deal Desk, & Pricing and Packaging Lead - Converge for Life Sciences_Products & Platforms
jobs.description:
**The Team**  
  
The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.  
  
This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.  
  
Rather than being aligned to a single product, this role sits within the Converge for Life Sciences commercial operations function and supports deal structuring, contracting, and client success activities across the portfolio's full suite of software and AI-enabled offerings.  
  
**Position Summary**  
  
As the Senior Consultant for Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Pricing and Packaging, you will serve as the commercial engine behind the Converge for Life Sciences go-to-market motion. You will own the full lifecycle of software license transactions, including all software license order renewals, partner with commercial strategy to design creative and innovative pricing and packaging models for software, technology, and IP offerings, and help ensure clients realize ongoing value from the platforms they adopt. Working across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Sales leadership, you will bring commercial structure and discipline to a growing, multi-product portfolio.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/23/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
**Deal Desk, Contracting & License Renewals:**  

* Own end-to-end management of all software license order renewals, ensuring accurate, on-time execution and continuity of client subscriptions across the portfolio.
* Lead the full commercial contracting lifecycle: drafting offering summaries, securing internal approvals, engaging clients, drafting license agreements, routing risk and legal reviews, and executing signed agreements.
* Build and maintain the commercial artifact(s) of record used to track deal status, payment milestones, and renewal timing across a staggered, multi-client portfolio.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for ad hoc contracting questions, coordinating with Legal/Risk on approvals so deals move cleanly from shaping through execution.

  
**Pricing & Packaging Strategy:**  

* Support the design of creative, innovative commercial models for new and existing software, technology, and IP offerings, including tiering structures, usage- and overage-based mechanics, margin targets, and contract exit terms.
* Partner with Product Management to establish a consistent point in the product development lifecycle at which pricing and packaging work begins, so commercial readiness keeps pace with new product launches.
* Build repeatable pricing frameworks and playbooks that scale as the software and AI-enabled product portfolio grows.
* Evaluate and recommend licensing structures (e.g., subscription, consumption-based, transitional/migration licensing) that balance client adoption with long-term revenue durability.

  
**Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment:**  

* Act as the connective tissue across Finance, Legal/Risk, Product, and Leadership on commercial and contractual matters, ensuring the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time.
* Partner with Finance on forecasting and cost modeling tied to commercial offerings, and support Legal/Risk in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions.
* Identify and help resolve cross-functional commercial issues that don't have a natural owner, bringing structure and follow-through to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations.

  
**Customer Success & Adoption:**  

* Partner with Account, Product, and Practice teams to support client adoption, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing messaging once a product is live, without duplicating relationship-management work already owned by those teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources, including practice expertise, product teams, and leadership, to resolve client-facing adoption issues and maintain a consistent client experience post-sale.
* Monitor client health signals tied to commercial terms, such as renewal risk or usage against contracted tiers, and proactively flag concerns to the broader account team.

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration:**  

* Comfortable operating as both a leader and a connector across Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal/Risk, and Account teams.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a staggered portfolio of concurrent deals, renewals, and client engagements at different stages simultaneously.
* Clear, confident communicator, able to bring structure to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations without a predefined playbook.
* Self-directed ownership mindset; comfortable being accountable for outcomes that span multiple functions with no single predefined owner.

  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
* 4-6 years of combined experience in deal desk, commercial contracting, pricing and packaging, sales operations, or customer success roles, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
